ctx.x: What Lyman is that? Is that --

They added Lewis Taylor now with Earl Hines, on trombone and none other than Lionel Hampton on drums. Lionel had been brought out from Milwaukee by Reb Spikes and had settled in Los Angeles. He was playing an awful lot then, though he had not yet taken up the vibes. He did play his two-finger piano which he originated contrary to other reports.
